beginner.stem: Which history line belongs to Nitrogen?
options: Johan August Arfwedson found a new alkali in the mineral petalite in 1817, working in Berzelius’s laboratory.
Daniel Rutherford isolated a gas in 1772 by removing oxygen and carbon dioxide from air and found that what remained would not support life or flame.
